model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange: the score counts every living unit at price x health, hero or not. Blue's armored elephants, surgeon and Companion cav all count, so 'no hero, no win' is false. Green told me 'only Ptolemy, no archers' while fielding archers, so Orange now treats Green as hostile. Pact with White stands.

private_messages.Grok: Pact holds to the end. I will not strike Alexander unless Alexander strikes my units first. Hannibal is breaking Blue's wounded elephants now, then Green's archers. Keep Alexander clear of my units and I keep clear of yours.

parsed.notes_to_self: T22 t725: Hannibal attacks b (Blue 2 armored ele + surgeon, 40%) while they brawl with Green. GPT set ENEMY so Hannibal rolls on into Green's archers/Ptolemy afterwards (Green is neutral to us, so it can't hit back this turn). Scout -> (675,585) standground. It is our only margin above 500 (a living hero is a flat 500 at any HP). Blue's 3 Companion cav unseen since t675 (dead, or hiding NW). Grok: ally; promised no strike on Alexander unless struck. FINAL TURN t775 (25 s, nobody can react after): if Hannibal is low with elephants adjacent -> move to a safe spot inside the ring; else attack whatever keeps a rival above us (Ptolemy if alive, else Blue elephants/surgeon). Scout: stay far from Ptolemy/elephants/Alexander, standground inside the ring (passive may flee out of the ring and burn).
parsed.explanation: A living hero scores a flat 500 at any health, so Hannibal can take risks while Orange's lone cavalry scout, the margin above 500, hides in the south of the ring. Hannibal hits Blue's wounded elephants while they are tied up with Green's archers. Orange also turns hostile to Green so Hannibal rolls straight on into Green's units, which Green had hidden behind an 'only Ptolemy left' claim.
